texts.D: Call D: a business in Massanassa. 4 workers trapped at their workplace. Most of the workers are Spanish. One of the workers needs dialysis within 24 hours. Water 1.3 m deep and rising; waiting for help for 45 minutes so far.
texts.E: Call E: Francisco Pérez, a permanent resident of the area, living in a residential street in Massanassa. 8 people trapped in the home; water 2 m deep and rising; waiting for help for 90 minutes so far.
